message.content: Keysight Technologies sells technology solutions that serve as mission-critical design enablement partners for engineering challenges across end markets including AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. The company generates revenue from its Communications Solutions Group and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group, with the former reporting $1,345 million in revenue and the latter reporting $501 million for the third quarter ended July 31, 2026 [D1]. Customers rely on Keysight to bridge virtual design and physical reality, enabling confident decisions earlier in the product lifecycle [D1].
